decisions.note: adr/0021 declared in its own Consequences that nothing enforced the Universal Agnostic Architecture Principle; UAC-000001 is that enforcement, fourteen days later. An axis is scored on two properties because one over-reports: how many implementations define the contract's own abstract methods, and whether the contract can fail at all. Measured: persistence PROVEN at 10/10 behind a contract that round-trips the universe and refuses a mechanism storing nothing; execution ENVELOPE_ONLY at 2/11 behind a contract demanding only a serialisation, where nine adapters share one transcribe() and execute() discards the payload to call the Python resolver. Across the repository 42 abstraction boundaries exist and 20 carry two or more implementations, but most are rule registries where swapping changes which rule runs, not which technology runs it — counting those as agnosticism is the over-report this instrument refuses. Lands as MEASUREMENT: it refuses nothing and changes no test's verdict.

decisions.note: Two rules governed thirteen commits and existed only in conversation, which CEP-002 Article 28.5 holds is not recorded at all.
